message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors: imports from JUnit 4 (org.junit.Assert, org.junit.Test) but project likely uses JUnit 5 (org.junit.jupiter.api). The code also mixes JUnit 5 imports. So we should replace JUnit 4 imports with JUnit Jupiter equivalents.

In JUnit 5, assertions are in org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions static import. So change import static org.junit.Assert.*; to import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*; and remove org.junit.Test import; use org.junit.jupiter.api.Test for test annotation (already imported). Also we have duplicate imports for Test from JUnit Jupiter and JUnit 4; we need only one.

Thus modify imports:

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

Remove org.junit.Test import and org.junit.Assert static import.

Also we have import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource; and ParameterizedTest etc. Those are fine.

Potential other issues: The test expecting exception for null zone but not using assertThrows. As is, test will just call Message.newUpdate(nullZone); If method throws NullPointerException, test passes; but JUnit will treat uncaught exception as failure unless expected. In JUnit5, you need assertThrows. However compilation not error. Could keep but maybe better to use assertThrows to be proper.

Also test newUpdate_invalidName_nonAbsolute_throwsIllegalArgumentException does not assert exception. Could also use assertThrows.

But not required for compilation.

Thus final corrected code.

Also need to import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension. Already there.

Remove duplicate import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test; there is already one.

Let's produce corrected file.
